item.tib: bder gshegs dgongs pa kun 'dus 'chi med gsang ba sum dril rgyud las 'chi med sku gsum gsang ba sum dril gyi gzhung
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rat+na gling pa'am 'chi med 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsal lam/ ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi mas chu sprel cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por thugs sprul rtag tu ngu ba'i ri bo'i byang phyogs dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug gi chu srin gre ba nas gter du spyan drangs te/ slar lo gcig dang zla ba gsum gyi bka' rgya grol mtshams mkhas mang 'dab rgya bzhed pa'i gnyen gcig g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po dang / spa rigs bstan 'dzin tshul khrims dbang rgyal gtsos rang dgon bla grwa du ma nas bskul ba dang / nye bar o rgyan bde chen gling pa'i rgyud 'dzin rgyal sras pad+ma 'phrin las dpal bzang po sras yum lhan rgyas rab dkar lha rdzas kyis mtshams sbyar nas phran gyi bka' gter gang yod mthar thon gyis shig pa'i bskul ba ((ma) la brten dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo'i sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i nyin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dus chen skabs su dpal gshen bstan g.yung drung rab brtan gling gi bla brang gi gzim dkyil gzhal med 'od gsal khang du shog ser la zhal bshus shing drung yig pa ni gter slob tshul khrims blo ldan nas bskran zhing yi ge dang po'i 'du byed 'gru bon g.yang 'degs pas byas pas gsang chen bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
